projects.title: CyRisk Insight Engine
projects.shortDescription: Cybersecurity platform for large-scale threat intelligence analysis
projects.description: Event-driven cybersecurity platform processing 5M+ threat records with microservices architecture. Implemented Redis Pub/Sub messaging for real-time updates and serverless pipelines for threat intelligence processing.
projects.context: US cybersecurity company needed scalable threat intelligence platform to process millions of security events daily while maintaining real-time response capabilities.
design_decisions: Redis Pub/Sub chosen over Kafka for lower latency requirements
Serverless architecture for cost optimization at variable loads
Elasticsearch for complex threat query patterns
Multi-tenant design for SaaS scalability

projects.title: Mevrik Digital Customer Experience Platform
projects.shortDescription: Backend architecture for AI-driven customer care supporting 10K+ concurrent users
projects.description: Designed and built core microservice architecture using Django, FastAPI, and PostgreSQL. Integrated Kafka for asynchronous processing and WebSockets for real-time communication, maintaining 99.9% uptime.
projects.context: Customer care platform needed to handle high-concurrency chat systems with NLP integration while maintaining enterprise-grade reliability.
design_decisions: Kafka over Redis for message durability in chat systems
WebSockets for low-latency real-time communication
Docker containerization for deployment consistency
Microservice separation by business domain

projects.title: Event-Driven Data Pipeline
projects.shortDescription: High-throughput data processing system with Redis Pub/Sub architecture
projects.description: Engineered scalable event-driven data pipeline for real-time ingestion from multiple sources. Implemented Redis Pub/Sub messaging, error handling, and monitoring for 24/7 operation.
projects.context: Multi-source data ingestion system required real-time processing capabilities with fault tolerance and horizontal scaling.
design_decisions: Redis Pub/Sub for low-latency message distribution
Circuit breaker pattern for downstream service protection
Dead letter queues for failed message handling
Prometheus metrics for observability

projects.title: Legacy System Migration to Serverless
projects.shortDescription: Modernized threading-based system to Azure Functions architecture
projects.description: Led migration of legacy threading-based system to serverless Azure Functions architecture. Achieved 40% cost reduction while improving scalability and maintainability through cloud-native design.
projects.context: Legacy system with threading bottlenecks needed modernization for cloud-native scalability and cost efficiency.
design_decisions: Azure Functions over VMs for variable workload optimization
Event-driven triggers replacing polling mechanisms
Managed services to reduce operational overhead
Terraform for reproducible infrastructure

aiProjects.title: IR Tool (RAG Pipeline)
aiProjects.shortDescription: AI application converting media into structured business content
aiProjects.description: Architected LangChain-based RAG pipeline with Azure OpenAI integration for intelligent document processing. Converts audio/video content into actionable business insights with 95%+ accuracy.
aiProjects.context: Business intelligence teams needed automated way to extract insights from unstructured media content for decision-making.
design_decisions: RAG over fine-tuning for dynamic knowledge updates
Azure services for enterprise compliance requirements
LangChain for flexible LLM orchestration
Vector embeddings in Cosmos DB for semantic search
